_comment: Map B of the brief 'maps for the Antebellum South lecture' (2026-11-16): four revolts and conspiracies, 1800 to 1831, as point records (tests/maps/antebellum-records.csv, TEST ROWS, sources PENDING OWNER) on the map of 21 August 1831. Two were planned and stopped before they began (Gabriel's, Vesey's): the grammar has no mark for that, so all four are drawn alike and their names say which. Three of the four predate the map's date; the packing slip warns of each.
title: Slave revolts and conspiracies, 1800 to 1831
